package policy

const sectionKey = "policy"

// ParseConfig is the registered [policy] decoder.
func ParseConfig(tree map[string]interface{}) []string {
	t, _ := tree[sectionKey].(map[string]interface{})
	v, _ := t["allow"].([]string)
	return v
}

// ParseBypass is a second decoder no family registers.
func ParseBypass(tree map[string]interface{}) bool {
	t, _ := tree["policy"].(map[string]interface{})
	b, _ := t["bypass"].(bool)
	return b
}
